exercises.question: Which sentence uses *hasta el punto de que* with the right preposition and mood for a real past result?
options: La mesa redonda se alargó hasta el punto de que el moderador pide brevedad.
La mesa redonda se alargó hasta el punto de que el moderador pidió brevedad.
La mesa redonda se alargó hasta el punto de que el moderador pidiera brevedad.

exercises.sentence: Conviene organizar el cierre de tal manera que cada ponente ____ dos minutos.
exercises.english: It is advisable to organise the wrap-up in such a way that each speaker has two minutes.

exercises.sentence: La ponencia presentó la síntesis con tanta contundencia que nadie pidió otra intervención.
options: The presentation delivered the summary with such forcefulness that everyone asked for another turn.
The presentation delivered the summary with such forcefulness that nobody asked for another turn.
The presentation delivered the summary with such forcefulness that the moderator asked for another turn.
The presentation delivered the summary so briefly that nobody asked for another turn.

exercises.sentence: El debate en el foro creció hasta el ____ de que ambas partes aceptaron una pausa.
exercises.english: The debate in the forum grew to the point that both sides accepted a pause.
exercises.hint: noun in hasta el ___ de que

exercises.question: What main objection does the male guest raise against a total ban on phones at school?
options: He denies that personal phone notifications distract students during school lessons.
He argues that a simple ban does not teach young people to use phones responsibly outside school.
He claims that school computers are far more distracting than personal phones in class.

exercises.question: What does the female guest say after she asks the male guest not to distort her position?
options: She says schools can teach digital skills on school computers rather than private phones.
She concedes that digital education should only begin after students finish secondary school.
She suggests that students bring two separate personal devices into the classroom.

exercises.question: Why does the female guest say it is difficult for teachers to manage personal phones in class?
options: Because schools lack clear rules on how to organise round tables.
Because families refuse to let teachers confiscate school computers.
Because it is almost impossible to monitor thirty personal screens at the same time.

prompt.speaker: Meg
prompt.text: Carlos, ¿cómo terminó la mesa redonda a la que asististe con tus compañeros?

options: El moderador hizo la síntesis de tal manera que todas las posturas quedaron claras en el cierre.
El moderador hizo la síntesis de tal manera todas las posturas quedaron claras en el cierre.
El moderador hizo la síntesis de tal manera de que todas las posturas quedaron claras en el cierre.

exercises.english: The debate escalated to the point that they asked for a pause.

exercises.question: Which word best completes the sentence: 'Al final del foro, el moderador ofreció una breve ____ de los acuerdos alcanzados'?
options: contundencia
ponencia
síntesis
